note: Milestone 70 per-spec static counts of expect calls and test declarations. tests/unit/ms70-assertion-counts.spec.js fails when a spec falls below either count; lowering one requires --reason, recorded in dropLog (kind: expects, tests or file). dropLog.reason: 70T: the two expects pinning that 51E's deleted window.* bridges stay deleted (and its kept ones stay published) moved to tests/unit/removed-window-bridges.spec.js -- a browser spec now names no app global but GuardianForms, not even to prove one absent.
70T: the expect that 44C's readiness dispatcher and per-type bridges are absent from window moved to tests/unit/removed-window-bridges.spec.js; the one-card assertions stay here.

70T: the whole spec moved to tests/unit/case-resolver.spec.js (same five tests, same 18 expects, direct imports): it tested pure case-resolver.js logic, and its identity checks cannot be observed through GuardianForms.testing copies.

70T: the test of saveBlobAs()'s pre-write validator contract (a refusal throws AbortError before anything is opened for writing) moved to tests/unit/case-file.spec.js, where it is checked on the module with a control; the filer's path through that validator -- the dashboard Backup button refusing to overwrite the case file -- stays here.

70T: 26 of its 29 tests (165 expects) moved to tests/unit/party-resolver.spec.js unchanged apart from running on the modules directly: pure resolver logic whose identity checks GuardianForms.testing's copies cannot show. The three .sav round-trip tests (13 expects) stay here.

70T: Slice 19E's three architecture expects (window.calcTotalsAnnual loaded before the PDF module and never swapped) moved to tests/unit/annual-accounting-totals.spec.js, which checks the module graph itself; the preview-to-PDF drift guard stays here.

70T: the Rename Ward dialog steps (two expects) were dropped -- no button has opened that dialog since the Milestone 36 dashboard consolidation (e5fb9cf), so they proved nothing a filer can reach; it is recorded for 70B as dead. One expect was added (the close lands on the dashboard).

70T: 'unknown fragment names are rejected without a request' (two expects) moved to tests/unit/fragment-loader.spec.js, checked on the module with every request recorded and a control that the allowlisted name is fetched.

70B: excel-engine.spec.js pinned legacy-app.js's sanitizeForExcel() and the module's Node fallback as equal (reading the legacy regex out of the monolith's source, plus a delegation test). 70B deleted the legacy copy, so the two-copy comparison and delegation assertions went; the one implementation is tested directly against the same OWASP set, and a new test proves a window.sanitizeForExcel no longer changes what is written.

70D: plan-certificate-of-service.spec.js's check that certificateStarted is published as window.planCertificateStarted went with the publication -- its only reader was legacy-app.js's computeNavChecks(), whose Plan rules now import the function

70F: section-guidance-policy.spec.js's check that the policy is published as window.sectionGuidancePolicy went with the publication -- its only reader, the sidebar's marks, moved into src/core/status/nav-marks.js and imports it

Milestone 70, 70J: unit specs open filings in the case store instead of assigning window.D/window.caseFile, no assertion dropped by that; guardian-inventory-totals.spec.js 77 -> 76 because legacy-app.js's calc Proxy went -- the four checks on it (its exact line, its forwarding, its typo and missing-bridge throws) became three on its absence and on the headline total being handed the filing; ms70-case-authority.spec.js is new.

Milestone 70, 70K: legacy-bridge.spec.js and monolith-services.spec.js went with the two doors they held (src/legacy-bridge.js, src/core/runtime/monolith.js); their behavior -- provided once, loud when asked first -- is held by the new tests/unit/feature-services.spec.js; navigation-race.spec.ts and feature-lazy-boundary.spec.ts are new; no assertion dropped.
